id="c25" value="<b>What it costs.</b> Lambda: 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds free every month; a full run takes under a second today. Scheduler: 14 million invocations free. Parameter Store standard parameters: no charge. Reports are a few KB in S3. <b>The catch:</b> the Free plan closes after 6 months or when its credits run out, whichever comes first. Upgrade to the Paid plan before then and the leftover credits carry over. div.div: What it costs. Lambda: 1 million requests and 400,000 GB-seconds free every month; a full run takes under a second today. Scheduler: 14 million invocations free. Parameter Store standard parameters: no charge. Reports are a few KB in S3. The catch: the Free plan closes after 6 months or when its credits run out, whichever comes first. Upgrade to the Paid plan before then and the leftover credits carry over. OpenRouter bills separately.
